context: A teacher introduces a classic literature unit with passion
purpose: Teach: 古典/批評/情熱/幻想/イラスト/ペン/語学/くださる

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 今日から古典文学の単元に入りますよ。皆さん、心の準備はいいですか?
lines.en: Starting today, we're entering the classic literature unit. Everyone, are you mentally ready?
lines.style: Warm, animated teacher voice with rising excitement on the second sentence.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 先生、なんだか今日はいつも以上に情熱を感じます。
lines.en: Sensei, somehow today I sense even more passion from you than usual.
lines.style: Curious university student tone, half-teasing and respectfully observant.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: ふふ、わかりますか?私、古典の世界が大好きで、つい熱くなってしまうんです。
lines.en: Hehe, can you tell? I love the world of the classics so much I get carried away.
lines.style: Laughs softly, voice softens then brightens with genuine warmth.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: ノートにイラストまで描かれていますね。源氏物語の場面ですか?
lines.en: You've even drawn illustrations in your notes. Is that a scene from The Tale of Genji?
lines.style: Polite, slightly impressed, leaning in closer with mild, growing curiosity.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: そうなんです。ペンを取って、万年筆で描いた幻想的な月の場面。読むと別世界に行けますよ。
lines.en: Yes. I picked up my pen and drew a fantastical moon scene with my fountain pen. Reading it takes you to another world.
lines.style: Dreamy and immersive delivery, voice trailing into soft wonder by the end.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 僕は語学が中心で、批評の授業はあまり取ったことがないんですが、面白そうですね。
lines.en: I focus mainly on language studies, so I haven't taken many criticism classes, but it sounds fascinating.
lines.style: Thoughtful, slightly hesitant but increasingly intrigued as he speaks on.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: ぜひ挑戦してみてください。読み方を一緒に考えてくださると私も嬉しいです。
lines.en: Please do give it a try. It would make me happy if you'd think about the readings together with me.
lines.style: Encouraging, sincere, with the polite warmth of a teacher inviting a peer.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: わかりました。じゃあ来週から、先生の情熱に負けないように頑張ります。
lines.en: Understood. Then from next week, I'll do my best not to lose to your passion.
lines.style: Determined and slightly playful, ending on a confident, warm smile here.
